ledger: Gravity on plastic balls: balls rest at the bottom of the glass bowl and roll only when disturbed; no floating or unsupported suspension observed at any point (0:00-0:09)

Child's hand manipulation: ball motion at 0:02-0:08 is always co-located with hand contact or immediately follows a drop/stir; motion blur at 0:08 matches vigorous stirring by the hand inside the bowl
Ball count in bowl: increases from ~8 balls at 0:00 to ~11 by 0:02 while the child's hands are blurred in a dropping motion above the bowl; consistent with the child adding balls from the loose pile
Bowl displacement across table (0:04-0:08): bowl slides/rotates only while the child's hands grip the rim; visible contact provides the cause

Wind/airflow: outdoor patio setting shows no wind indicators; the leaf sprig on the decorative egg cup (right of table) and the child's thick fleece jacket remain static in every frame, consistent with calm air; no element streams or flutters, so no airflow is implied
Loose balls at bottom-right of table (0:00-0:02): remain stationary except when framing changes; no spontaneous motion
Lighting/shadows: daylight illumination on table, bowl, and child is stable across all frames with no flicker or shadow-direction jumps
